The two predicates, `(has ?e - entity ?i - item)` from domain_1 and `(has ?e - entity ?i - item)` from domain_2, are identical in name and arguments. They both represent the relationship where an entity `?e` possesses an item `?i`.  The predicates are used in similar contexts (buying, receiving, etc.), suggesting they represent the same underlying concept.  Merging them would simplify the domain description without introducing ambiguity or complexity. The predicates are not containing relationships, so rule (3) does not apply.
